verdict.rationale: Groq publishes an official TypeScript/JavaScript SDK (github.com/groq/groq-typescript) with documented usage, including typed calls such as audio transcriptions and flexible file-upload handling, so the product directly provides an official SDK. The evidence shows only that one official SDK; the docs' OpenAI client-library compatibility is a third-party workaround and earns no credit. missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs in other languages (e.g. Python), SDK versioning/release documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: This library provides convenient access to the Groq REST API from server-side TypeScript or JavaScript.
Request parameters that correspond to file uploads can be passed in many different forms
